metaTitle: RV Converter vs Inverter vs Inverter-Charger
description: Understand how an RV converter, inverter and inverter-charger differ, how they fit together and how to size and choose one for hookups or boondocking.
directAnswer: A converter turns shore AC into 12 V DC and charges the battery, an inverter turns battery DC into outlet AC, and an inverter-charger does both with a transfer switch. Most RVs ship with a converter only.
